Subject: Special Event with Business School Professor William Duggan



This message is being sent to you from the Columbia Alumni Association at http://www.alumniconnections.com/links/link.cgi?l=257943&h=179242&e=COU-20080211115706 . To see the message online, visit http://www.alumniconnections.com/links/link.cgi?l=257944&h=179242&e=COU-20080211115706 . 


Fairfield County Alumni Events 
 
Strategic Intuition: "How 'Aha!' Really Happens"
 
Thursday, February 28 
6:15 p.m. Reception
7:15 p.m. Program 
The Waters Edge at Giovanni's
2748 Post Road 
Darien

Join the Columbia University Club of Fairfield County (CUCFC) for an evening with Professor William Duggan.

Come hear Professor Duggan, author of three recent books on strategic intuition, as he explains how flashes of insight work in the mind and how you can use them to your best advantage in any human endeavor.
 
Preview Professor Duggan's presentation at: http://www.alumniconnections.com/links/link.cgi?l=257945&h=179242&e=COU-20080211115706
 
Connect with your fellow alumni, and enjoy hors d'oeuvres, beer, wine, soft drinks, and insightful discussion.

RSVP by February 21 by sending your checks payable to CUCFC to:
 
Ms. Claire Nathan
44 Strawberry Hill Avenue, Apt. 10G
Stamford, CT 06902

Questions? E-mail Claire Nathan at mbzyrfq3@optonline.net or call 203-978-1557.
 

Tickets:

$40 - CUCFC members and their guests
$45 - Nonmembers
